en: Do you have any special plans this weekend?
I don't have special plans, but I want to rest.
Shall we go eat something delicious?
Sounds good, I want to eat warm samgyetang.

bg-d-02-01.q: What does the second speaker want to do this weekend at first?
bg-d-02-01.why: The second speaker answers '특별한 계획은 없는데 쉬고 싶어요' (I don't have special plans, but I want to rest).

bg-d-02-01.q: What food does the second speaker want to eat?
bg-d-02-01.why: The speaker says '따뜻한 삼계탕을 먹고 싶어요' (I want to eat warm samgyetang).

bg-d-02-01.hint: I want to eat warm samgyetang.
bg-d-02-01.why: 먹다 + -고 싶어요 expresses the speaker's wish.

bg-d-02-01.q: A friend asks what you want to do on vacation. Express your desire to visit Jeju Island. Use 제주도 + direction particle -에 and 가다 + -고 싶어요.
bg-d-02-01.why: Attach -고 싶어요 to the verb stem 가: 제주도에 가고 싶어요.

items: Express personal wishes and desires using -고 싶다
Differentiate first-person desire (-고 싶어요) from third-person desire (-고 싶어하다)

ko: 오후 일곱 시에 친구를 만날 거예요.
네, 시내 식당에서 파스타를 먹을 거예요.
en: What are you going to do after work tomorrow?
I am going to meet a friend at 7 PM.
Are you having dinner with your friend?
Yes, we are going to eat pasta at a downtown restaurant.

bg-d-02-02.q: What time is the second speaker meeting their friend?
bg-d-02-02.why: The second speaker says '오후 일곱 시에 친구를 만날 거예요' (I am going to meet a friend at 7 PM).

bg-d-02-02.q: What will they eat for dinner?
bg-d-02-02.why: The text says '시내 식당에서 파스타를 먹을 거예요' (We are going to eat pasta at a downtown restaurant).

bg-d-02-02.hint: I will meet a friend at seven.
bg-d-02-02.why: 만나다 has no final consonant, attaching -ㄹ 거예요.

bg-d-02-02.q: A friend asks what you will do tomorrow. Reply with your plan to go to the library. Use 도서관 + direction particle -에 and 가다 + -(으)ㄹ 거예요.
bg-d-02-02.why: 가다 attaches -ㄹ 거예요 to express a future plan: 갈 거예요.

items: State confirmed future schedules and appointments using -(으)ㄹ 거예요
Correctly attach -(으)ㄹ 거예요 depending on the presence of 받침 or ㄹ

ko: 제주도 정말 좋으니까 꼭 가 보세요!
en: Where are you going during summer vacation?
I bought plane tickets, so I am going to Jeju Island.
Someday I want to go to Jeju too.
Jeju is really great, so definitely visit!

bg-d-02-03.q: Why does the second speaker know for sure they are going to Jeju?
options: It is close to their school
bg-d-02-03.why: The speaker explains '비행기표를 사서 제주도에 갈 거예요' (I bought plane tickets, so I am going to Jeju Island).

bg-d-02-03.q: How does the first speaker feel about visiting Jeju?
bg-d-02-03.why: The first speaker says '언젠가 저도 제주도에 가고 싶어요' (Someday I want to go to Jeju too).

bg-d-02-03.hint: Someday I want to go to Jeju too.
bg-d-02-03.why: An unconfirmed, heartfelt wish takes -고 싶어요.

bg-d-02-03.q: Express a future wish to travel to Europe someday. Use adverb 언젠가 with destination 유럽 and 가다 + -고 싶어요.
bg-d-02-03.why: Unscheduled wishes pair with 언젠가 and -고 싶어요.

items: Choose between -고 싶어요 (unbooked wish) and -(으)ㄹ 거예요 (booked plan)
Understand the communicative nuance of certainty versus longing

ko: 네, 콘서트에서 좋아하는 음악을 들을 거예요.
저도 그 가수 노래를 듣고 싶어요.
en: Are you going to the concert this weekend?
Yes, I will listen to my favorite music at the concert.
I want to hear that singer's songs too.
Next time, let's book tickets together!

bg-d-02-04.q: What will the second speaker do at the concert?
bg-d-02-04.why: The text states '콘서트에서 좋아하는 음악을 들을 거예요' (I will listen to my favorite music at the concert).

bg-d-02-04.q: What does the first speaker suggest for next time?
bg-d-02-04.why: The first speaker says '다음에는 우리 같이 표를 예매해요!' (Next time, let's book tickets together!).

bg-d-02-04.hint: I will listen to music at the concert.
bg-d-02-04.why: 듣다 changes ㄷ to ㄹ before vowel endings: 들을 거예요.

bg-d-02-04.q: A friend asks about your dinner plans. Reply that you will bake a cake. Use 케이크 + object particle -을/를 and 만들다 (ㄹ irregular) + -(으)ㄹ 거예요.
bg-d-02-04.why: Stems ending in ㄹ like 만들다 attach - 거예요 directly: 만들 거예요.

items: Correctly conjugate irregular stems like 듣다 (들어요/듣고 싶어요/들을 거예요)
Handle stems ending in ㄹ like 만들다 (만들 거예요) without adding extra 을
